blocks.heading: Mandatory Government Photo Identity Rules
blocks.intro: Every tourist entering Ranthambore Tiger Reserve must present a valid physical original government ID at the forest gate.

groups.title: Foreign & NRI Nationals
items: Original Passport with Valid Indian Visa / OCI Card
Digital phone copies or photocopies are strictly invalid at the gate

blocks.title: Warning
blocks.text:
Indian Nationals: PAN Cards and Student IDs are NOT valid. You must carry the exact original physical ID stated on your voucher.

Foreign & NRI Nationals: Passport details entered during booking must match the physical document presented at gate inspection.

blocks.heading: Comprehensive Safari Questions & Answers
blocks.intro: Click any question below to read the official Rajasthan Forest Department guidelines.

items.q: How far in advance can I book Ranthambore safari permits?
items.a: Online permit bookings open up to 90 to 120 days in advance. For core zones (1 to 5) and peak season weekends, booking 60 to 90 days ahead is strongly advised.

items.q: Can permits be cancelled, refunded, or rescheduled?
items.a: No. As per Rajasthan Forest Department regulations, confirmed safari permits are 100% non-refundable, non-reschedulable, and non-transferable under any circumstances.

items.q: How are safari zones assigned to tourists?
items.a: You can express a preference for Core or Buffer zones. The Forest Department computerized lottery system makes final allocations on the morning of the drive to balance forest traffic.

items.q: What is the difference between Gypsy and Canter?
items.a: The Maruti Gypsy is a 6-seater 4x4 open jeep offering nimble handling and eye-level photography angles. The Canter is a 20-seater open safari bus with high elevated vantage points.

items.q: What clothes should I wear on a safari?
items.a: Wear neutral earthy tones such as khaki, olive green, beige, or brown. In winter mornings (Nov-Feb), carry warm windbreakers and beanies as open jeeps get cold.

items.q: Is tiger sighting guaranteed on a safari?
items.a: Ranthambore is a vast wild protected sanctuary over 1,300 sq km, not a zoo. Sighting depends on patience, tracking, and nature. With 2 to 4 drives, sighting odds are exceptionally high.

blocks.heading: Prohibited Items & Strict Penalties
blocks.intro: Under the Wildlife Protection Act, carrying or using the following items is strictly illegal.

items.title: Zero Plastic & Littering
items.text: Single-use plastic bottles and polythene bags are banned. Carry reusable metal flasks.

items.title: No Smoking & No Alcohol
items.text: Carrying cigarettes, matches, or liquor into the reserve is a legal offense.

items.title: No Drones or Loud Music
items.text: Drones and loud speakers are prohibited under the Wildlife Protection Act.

items.title: Never Step Outside Vehicle
items.text: Stepping off the vehicle onto forest ground is illegal and dangerous.

items.title: Neutral Colors Only
items.text: Khaki, beige, olive green, grey, and dusty brown blend with the forest backdrop.

items.title: Dust Covers & Sunglasses
items.text: Protect eyes, nose, and camera gear from dry sandy dust with scarves and covers.

items.title: Winter Morning Layers
items.text: From November to February, mornings drop to 5°C. Carry warm fleece jackets and beanies.

blocks.title: Still Have Questions About Safari Rules?
blocks.text: Our on-ground Sawai Madhopur wildlife team is available daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM to assist with identity verification and permits.
